messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held devices are prohibited while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell‑Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and intersections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No “lane‑splitting” on highways. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in handicap spaces unless you have a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Stop in both directions unless a sign indicates otherwise. | TxDOT – School Bus Safety | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras enforce speed limits.
• Cameras may be used at intersections for red‑light violations. | TxDOT – Traffic Enforcement | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Annual safety inspection required for most vehicles. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Roadside Assistance & Accident Reporting** | • Report accidents involving injury, death, or property damage over $1,000 to the police. | TxDMV – Accident Reporting | ### Quick Resources - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – [www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – [www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) - **Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC)** – [www.tabc.texas.gov](https://www.tabc.texas.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online via the Texas Legislature website. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or regulation!
